title: micranthes astilboides
intro: Micranthes astilboides, commonly known as mountain saxifrage, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Micranthes astilboides include its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, and its potential to act as an anti-spasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and cramps. The bioactive constituents of Micranthes astilboides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
